product_one_liner.value: Design Arena lets creators generate websites, apps, images, videos and presentations with competing AI models, while helping AI researchers benchmark those models using user preferences.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation was found; the terms contain a No Fees section, subject to exceptions for limited additional features.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer-style case study describes Microsoft Research Asia using the benchmark, but does not establish two named customers; model providers and research collaborators are not counted as customers.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported count of 12 employees, rather than the separately displayed 1–10 company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Introducing Micro Evals and the HTML-to-PPTX implementation/open-source write-up, both by Grace Li, whose background includes software engineering.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes an introduction, quickstart, authentication and multiple endpoint references; API use requires an approved key.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Public documentation names these providers; the product evaluates and generates outputs with multiple models rather than relying on one exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page attributes SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications to cloud providers, not Design Arena itself; the privacy notice discusses GDPR as applicable law, not a company certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 3, 2026; led by Index Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 3, 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The five listed openings are technical roles and an open application; none is an SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Mobile Arena was introduced June 9, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small-team leadership review found no qualifying C-level or VP change during November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; founding CEO/CTO roles predate the window. Co-founder and Technical Chief of Staff additions do not by themselves qualify.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No named CRM or sales/marketing system appears in the reviewed public job posting and API documentation; this is not a claim that no such system is used internally.
